changelog:
v5.2.0 — A new look for Home, Movies, Series and Live TV

• New Home screen: big shortcuts to Live TV, TV Guide, Movies, Series, Catch Up and Favorites, with "Pick up where you left off" right at the top.

• Movies and Series now open on a large preview of the title you're on, with rows like Recently Added, Top Rated and New on your favorite services underneath. On Series, Keep Watching shows the season and episode.

• Shows in Pick Up & New open straight to the newest episode.

• New Live TV screen: the channel you're on plays full screen behind the list, with sound. Press OK to watch, hold OK to add or remove a favorite.

• Trailers now play inside the app instead of opening YouTube. Left and Right skip 10 seconds, Back returns.

• Series pages: ratings are now out of 10, and the season list no longer overlaps the Start over button on shows with many seasons.

• Smoother scrolling: rows no longer jump up and down while you browse.
